ImGui Binding
---
[Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) binding for Foundation.

See [Examples/ImGui](https://github.com/mos9527/Foundation/blob/vulkan/Examples/ImGui.cpp) for usage examples.

Sources are pulled via `FetchContent` (see `ThirdParty/CMakeLists.txt`):

- imgui - [ocornut/imgui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) `v1.92.7-docking`
- imguizmo - [hrydgard/ImGuizmo](https://github.com/hrydgard/ImGuizmo) `5088891e308f14556c6c961aac1be79e1fc1850f`
